prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production portrait upgrade for Tsumugi, an ADULT woman in her twenties, fictional medical academy. Image1 is exact character identity, UNIFORM, pose, composition to preserve; images2 and3 Nagi/Rei ONLY high-quality linework and clean hair painting references, do not copy their faces. Redraw image1 at native high detail 1024x1536 transparent, same head scale, face tilt, all proportions and crown-to-upper-thigh framing at exactly twice source coordinates. Warm amber almond eyes, tiny calm CLOSED smile, olive ash-brown hair, ivory/navy sailor uniform, muted dusty-rose third-year bow, pleated navy double-ivory-hem skirt, buttons/brooch, braided rose cord knot keyring. KEEP uniform design and original adult body proportions. Soft kind competent personality. User specifically requests LESS hair on VIEWER RIGHT: reduce the low side/nape chignon's bulk by about 35%, make ONE neat compact low bun, remove scraggly flyaways and extra looping hair around ear and neck, while retaining her recognisable long side-parted bangs and low-bun silhouette. The floral braided hair ornament and little gold key remain in their original place, scaled tastefully with tidy bun. Crown not tall; no extra hair puff. Preserve face shape, ORIGINAL eye size, nose/mouth distances. Natural warm pale skin matching Nagi/Rei, not bleached white. Fine confident anime contours, precise iris facets and lashes, softly defined cel shading, coherent fine strands on darker ash-brown base without washed-out haze. Normal neutral indoor lighting, same brightness as other cast. Absolutely no blur, lens bloom or luminous rim. True transparent alpha outside silhouette AND hair gaps, no background or vignette, no labels. Image1 remains design authority.

Use case identity-preserve. Edit the adult Tsumugi portrait into her NEW feminine casual outfit. Keep EXACT image's face, head dimensions/tilt/position, warm amber eyes, natural skin, finely painted ash-brown hair and compact tidy LOW BUN on viewer right. Same 1024x1536 composition, scale and cropped thigh framing. Change ONLY clothing/accessories and modest hand position. Practical gentle crafts-club senior on a quiet afternoon. Ivory woven cotton blouse with small rounded square neckline, small pearl buttons on the front, short softly gathered sleeves with delicate narrow cuff, very subtle fine pintucks, no frilly costume. Dusty olive/sage high-waisted A-line skirt, clean soft folds, narrow self-fabric waistband, hem just above knee/bottom crop. A small warm dark-brown leather rounded shoulder bag, short strap down her viewer-left shoulder, kept close at hip; her viewer-left hand lightly holding the strap near lower ribs, other arm relaxed down. No hands in pockets, no crossed arms. Keep the rose braided knot charm on bag hardware; use a small matching braided dusty-rose hair tie on tidy low bun, remove long gold key from hair for casual. Feminine, neat and relaxed, not business suit or old-fashioned. NOT overalls, work shorts, cargo, knitwear, cardigan, blazer, necktie, heels, bulky jacket. Preserve adult body proportions, no body changes, neckline tasteful. Crisp matching fine Japanese anime contours and restrained cel shading, same neutral indoor brightness as master. Hair must stay tidy with less viewer-right volume and no flyaways. True transparent background and hair gaps, no glow/halo or shadows outside silhouette; no text. One centered portrait.

Keep exact front bangs from master. No earring, no gold key, no floral ornament. Same quiet closed smile and original hand pose as image1. Same high-quality Nagi/Rei-like fine lines, controlled cel shadows, nuanced clear irises, natural indoor brightness. No body changes. True alpha outside silhouette and hair gaps, no backdrop, vignette, halo, blur, labels. One portrait.

Cell2 top-right: warmly pleased, eyes CLOSED in relaxed upward arcs, gently open cheerful smile, not huge screaming laugh. Use case: identity-preserve, technical blink atlas. Edit ONLY eyes in the referenced 1536x1024 Tsumugi atlas. This atlas is only for natural blinking layered under each authored emotional brow.
